Ivy R: Heads up 10: Polaris Bio found they were billed during their 30-day trial window on INV-2026-09-01-PB. They should
be in trial; requesting refund/credit. Can finance ops advise?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-09-01-PB posted 2026-09-01 08:03Z. Total: $3,450.00. Status: paid. PDF: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-09-01-PB

Trevor (Acct Rep): Customer provided screenshots showing trial start date 2026-08-05 and trial flag on account. Looks like our trial enforcement lambda didn't block billing for a subset of usage events.

Maya (CS): Polaris is upset since trial was a condition of the pilot. They want the full amount refunded to card and a corrected invoice showing $0 due. Also asked for a quick note we can send to legal.

Ivy R: Invoice lines:
```
account,description,qty,unit_price,line_total
PB-900,Hosted tokens - usage,1,3000.00,3000.00
PB-900,Support trial add-on,1,450.00,450.00
```

Ivy R: We should refund $3,450 and mark the invoice as reissued (0 net). Proposal: create credit memo and process CC refund. Tag with adj reason FIN-TRIAL-2026-321.

Priya (Dir Finance): Approve refund to CC for the full amount. Please include root cause notes and booking entries. If trial enforcement bug is our fault, mark as goodwill and book to Contra Revenue 4010. Also include a chargeback to Trial Controls GL for tracking (GL code 4505).

Ivy R: Will create CM-2026-1602 for -3450.00 and attach FIN-TRIAL-2026-321. Will set memo: "Trial-flag missed; full refund as goodwill."

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-1602 created and linked to INV-2026-09-01-PB. Status: pending_refund. Reference FIN-TRIAL-2026-321.

Hannah (Payments): Need original payment ID and last4 to process CC refund. Trevor please DM details. Refund processing ETA 5 biz days; processor fee reversal may apply.

Trevor (Acct Rep): DM'ed payment PAY-334455 and card **** 3781. Polaris confirmed they want refund to that card.

Hannah (Payments): Refund submitted 2026-09-02 11:05Z, processor ref R-778899. Amount $3,450. Estimated posting 3-5 business days. Accounting impact: reverse merchant fees per policy; book reversal under 6420.

Maya (CS): Customer notified and happy with the quick fix. They asked for an incident note they can share with stakeholders; attaching a one-paragraph explanation.

Ivy R: Also creating billing incident ticket BI-2026-410 to root cause the trial enforcement lambda and add an automated test to billing QA. Assigning to eng-billing.

Priya (Dir Finance): Thanks all. Please capture the refund in the monthly manual adjustments report and include FIN-TRIAL-2026-321 in the notes.

Trevor (Acct Rep): Closing on my side after refund posts. Will update customer when R-778899 shows as posted.

Ivy R: Good work team. Reminder: keep manual refunds under the manual refund SLA and limit.
